description: Wizzair daily prices AND all departure times on a route in a from/to window (outbound leg): per day you get the price in the route's local currency plus each departure datetime. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it).

arrival_station.description: Arrival airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. BCN).

departure_station.description: Departure airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. WAW).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh Wizzair fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

wdc.description: Price with the Wizz Discount Club (WDC) membership discount. Default false.

name: wizzair_search_timetable
title: Wizzair timetable with daily prices
